messages.content:
You label replies in one Telegram discussion thread. Topic of interest: ethereum.

For EVERY message id in `comments` return one object:
  id             the comment id
  entity         what the reply is about: one of ["bitcoin", "cpi", "eth", "ethereum", "витальевич", "даня", "кристина", "кристину", "фрс"], or "other", or "unknown"
  topic_relation relation to the topic ethereum:
                   direct      the reply itself talks about ethereum (by any name, slang included)
                   contextual  it is about ethereum or the post's claim about ethereum only through the
                               post or a parent message it answers (e.g. "2500 must hold?" under a post
                               that sets 2500 for ethereum)
                   unrelated   another subject (banter, other assets with no link to ethereum)
                   unclear     cannot tell from the text and its parents
  aspect         market (price, trading, cycle), payment (ethereum used to pay / as gas / wallet),
                 technology, other
  stance         toward ethereum as an asset: support / oppose / mixed / unclear
  claim          the argument in <=15 words of English, or null if there is none (jokes, banter, bare questions)
  evidence_ids   ids that justify topic_relation: its own id for direct; for contextual the "post" and/or
                 the parent / ancestor ids that carry the link. Being in the same thread is NOT evidence.

Rules: judge each reply with its reply chain; do not assume a reply is about ethereum because the post is.
A price in a currency is not payment. Sarcasm counts as its real meaning; if unsure, stance "unclear".
Answer with JSON only: {"labels": [ ... ]}
